US.description: Includes federal income tax, FICA (Social Security & Medicare), and an estimated average state income tax for a single earner.

IN.description: Includes central income tax and 4% health and education cess under the new tax regime, assuming no specific deductions for an equivalent $85k USD earner.

SG.description: Effective personal income tax rate for an $85k USD earner, based on Singapore's progressive tax system. No capital gains tax.

CH.description: Includes federal, cantonal, and communal income taxes, plus mandatory social security contributions, highly variable by canton and commune.

NL.description: Includes income tax and mandatory social security contributions.

GB.description: Includes income tax and National Insurance contributions.

CA.description: Includes federal and provincial income taxes, plus mandatory contributions for Canada Pension Plan (CPP) and Employment Insurance (EI).

AE.description: No personal income tax is levied on an $85k USD earner in the UAE.

NO.description: Effective rate includes national income tax (trinnskatt), municipal income tax, and mandatory social security contributions for an $85k USD earner.

IE.description: Includes Income Tax, Universal Social Charge (USC), and Pay Related Social Insurance (PRSI) for a single earner.

LU.description: Includes progressive income tax and mandatory social security contributions for a single earner.

AU.description: Includes federal income tax and Medicare levy for an $85k USD equivalent earner.

QA.description: No personal income tax for residents. Social security contributions may apply for Qatari nationals.

BN.description: Brunei Darussalam has no personal income tax for its residents or foreigners.

MO.description: Macao's Professional Tax (income tax) is calculated progressively with a substantial tax-free threshold. Other taxes like VAT are absent.
